observations.statement: CrazyGames requires an initial download size of at most 50MB, and at most 20MB for mobile homepage eligibility.
observations.excerpt: The game must have an initial download size ≤ 50MB . In order to be eligible for the mobile homepage, the initial download size needs to be ≤ 20MB.

observations.statement: CrazyGames allows a maximum total file size of 250MB and 1500 files.
observations.excerpt: A maximum total file size of 250MB is allowed. There's a file count limit on 1500 files as high file counts will make loading slower.

observations.statement: For externally loaded files, CrazyGames QA evaluates time to reach gameplay against 20 seconds.
observations.excerpt: For externally hosted/loaded files our QA team will evaluate based on the time it takes to reach gameplay (≤ 20 seconds)

observations.statement: CrazyGames expects games to work on Chrome and Edge and disables games on Safari that don't work well there.
observations.excerpt: We expect games to work on Chrome and Edge. Games that don't work well on Safari will be disabled on that browser.

observations.statement: CrazyGames disables games on Chromium OS if they don't run smoothly on a 4GB RAM device.
observations.excerpt: A significant segment of the CrazyGames audience uses Chromebook. Games will be disabled on Chromium OS if they do not work smoothly on a 4GB RAM device.

observations.statement: Unity games are disabled on iOS by default on CrazyGames.
observations.excerpt: Unity games will be disabled on iOS by default due to frequent crashes (caused by memory shortage).

observations.statement: CrazyGames requires games to support mouse, keyboard, and touch if mobile is supported, and to be playable in landscape on desktop.
observations.excerpt: Game supports mouse, keyboard, and touch if mobile is supported. Game should be playable in landscape mode on desktop.
